findings.justification: Operating income of $35,695M divided by revenue of $109,417M equals 32.6%, which exceeds 30%. This directly establishes the operating margin for Q3 2026 ended June 27, 2026.
The derived metric shows operating margin of 32.62% for the quarter ended June 27, 2026, which exceeds 30%.
The consolidated statement of operations shows operating income of $35,695M and total net sales of $109,417M for the three months ended June 27, 2026. The ratio is 32.6%, exceeding 30%.
Operating income of $35,695M divided by revenue of $109,417M equals 0.3262 (32.62%), which is greater than 0.3 (30%).
The derived operating margin metric of 0.3262 for the quarter ended June 27, 2026 exceeds 0.3.
